description: This file defines functions and constants for handling authentication choice options, including building options and groups for CLI interfaces, resolving provider choices, and formatting choices for display. It imports types and functions from other modules related to auth profiles, configuration, flows, and static options.

methods.name: compareOptionLabels
methods.description: Compares two AuthChoiceOption objects based on their label for sorting.

methods.name: compareAssistantOptions
methods.description: Compares two AuthChoiceOption objects based on assistantPriority and label for sorting.

methods.name: compareGroupLabels
methods.description: Compares two AuthChoiceGroup objects based on their label for sorting.

methods.name: resolveProviderChoiceOptions
methods.description: Resolves provider choices based on configuration, workspace, and environment, returning an array of AuthChoiceOptions.

methods.name: formatAuthChoiceChoicesForCli
methods.description: Formats available auth choice options into a pipe-separated string for CLI display, including static and provider options.

methods.name: buildAuthChoiceOptions
methods.description: Builds a list of AuthChoiceOptions based on store, inclusion of skip, and visibility filters.

methods.name: buildAuthChoiceGroups
methods.description: Builds groups of AuthChoiceOptions, optionally including a skip option, and sorts them.
